test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven people Z, H, B, W, S, R, and G are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only two people sit to the left of S. Only two people sit to the right of H. Only H sits between G and Z. Only S sits between W and G. B sits at the extreme right of the row. Who sits at the extreme left of the row?
solution: Seven people **Z, H, B, W, S, R, and G** are sitting in a straight row, facing north. 1. Only two people sit to the left of S. 2. Only two people sit to the right of H. 3. B sits at the extreme right of the row.
